user.title: BLE Fingerprint Positioning
user.description: Pick the device to track: its distance sensors (e.g. Bermuda) are found automatically.

data_description.device_id: All of its “distance to …” sensors are used.
data_description.name: If left empty: “Posizione” followed by the device name.

data_description.sensors: Distance sensors (in meters) to use in addition to, or instead of, the device ones.

error.no_sensors: No distance sensor found: pick a device with enabled “distance to” sensors or select the sensors manually.

data_description.device_id: All of its “distance to …” sensors are used.
data_description.confirmation_seconds: Seconds the new room must stay the best match before switching (0 = immediate).
data_description.unknown_timeout: Seconds without any valid proxy before the position becomes unknown (0 = never).
data_description.smoothing: Kalman filter on the coordinates: fewer jumps, with a slight lag when moving.

data_description.sensors: Distance sensors (in meters) to use in addition to, or instead of, the device ones.
data_description.trilateration: Estimate the proxy positions from vertices with coordinates and use them to refine x/y together with the fingerprint.
data_description.map_scale: 1 if the vertex coordinates are in metres, 100 if in centimetres, etc.
data_description.max_distance: Distances at or above this are ignored; an unseen proxy is treated as being at this distance.
data_description.top_k: Number of most similar vertices used to pick the room and compute the coordinates.
data_description.min_common_proxies: Proxies the current reading and a vertex must share for the vertex to be considered.

error.no_sensors: No distance sensor found: pick a device with enabled “distance to” sensors or select the sensors manually.

save_vertex.name: Save vertex
save_vertex.description: Save a reference point (fingerprint) in the map with manually provided distances.

vertex_id.name: Vertex ID
vertex_id.description: Unique point identifier within the room (overwritten if it exists).

distances.name: Distances
distances.description: Map of distance sensor → measured meters at this point.

x.name: X
x.description: Point X coordinate (optional, in map units). x and y are needed for trilateration.

y.name: Y
y.description: Point Y coordinate (optional, in map units).

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Floor of the point (optional, e.g. “Ground”, “Basement”). Only needed with several floors.

record_vertex.name: Record vertex
record_vertex.description: Read the device's current distances (median over the given duration) and save them as a vertex. Stand still at the point while recording.

vertex_id.name: Vertex ID
vertex_id.description: Unique point identifier within the room (overwritten if it exists).

entity_id.name: Position sensor
entity_id.description: BLE Fingerprint sensor to read the distances from (only needed if you have more than one).

x.name: X
x.description: Point X coordinate (optional, in map units). x and y are needed for trilateration.

y.name: Y
y.description: Point Y coordinate (optional, in map units).

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Floor of the point (optional, e.g. “Ground”, “Basement”). Only needed with several floors.

delete_vertex.name: Delete vertex
delete_vertex.description: Delete a vertex from the map.

vertex_id.name: Vertex ID
vertex_id.description: Identifier of the vertex to delete.

delete_room.name: Delete room
delete_room.description: Delete a room and all of its vertices from the map.

get_map.name: Get map
get_map.description: Return the saved map (rooms, vertices, manually set proxies and estimated proxies).

set_proxy.name: Set proxy
set_proxy.description: Manually set a proxy position (normally estimated from the vertices). Without x and y the manual setting is removed.

proxy.name: Proxy
proxy.description: Proxy name (the part after “distance_to_”) or one of its distance sensors.

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Floor of the point (optional, e.g. “Ground”, “Basement”). Only needed with several floors.

factor.name: Correction factor
factor.description: Measured distance / real distance (optional; estimated if omitted).
